Discarded Banquet Trays
Executive Chef Vikram & Banquet Staff — Mumbai Metro
ACT 1: THE PARADOX OF ABUNDANCE

Tons of Pristine Gourmet Feasts Dumped Nightly

Every evening in hotels, luxury wedding banquets, and convention caterers, magnificent platters of freshly prepared biryanis, aromatic curries, and warm breads are cooked for thousands of guests.

When the celebrations conclude, up to 40% of pristine, untouched food is discarded into municipal dumpsters — simply because chefs have no rapid, verified mechanism to route meals before freshness expires. Source: FSSAI & Hospitality Sector Estimates

68M+ Tonnes
Edible food wasted annually in India
Source: UNEP Food Waste Index Report
₹92,000 Cr
Economic value lost to dumpsters
Source: UN & Indian Food Waste Economic Assessment

“It breaks my heart to throw away 120 portions of rich gourmet food every midnight while homeless families sleep outside our kitchen gates.”

— Executive Chef Rajesh Singhania, Banquet Partner
The Silent Survival
Sister Maria with shelter children & daily-wage workers
ACT 2: THE HUMAN COST

194 Million Citizens Struggle to Survive Day-to-Day

Barely three kilometers from illuminated luxury banquet halls, vulnerable children, daily-wage laborers, and abandoned senior citizens sit in dim community shelters with empty plates.

Mothers skip their own single meal so their children might have bread. Underfunded NGO shelters run out of provisions before dusk, surviving day by day on uncertain donations.

194 Million
Under-nourished people in India
Source: FAO (UN) SOFI Report
1 in 3
Malnourished children worldwide reside here
Source: UNICEF Global Nutrition Data

“Our shelter beds are full, but our pantry was empty. We survived on boiled lentils while good banquet food was discarded just down the avenue.”

— Sister Maria, Hope Horizon Shelter Coordinator

SOLUTION : THE INTELLIGENCE BRIDGE

Smart Rescue Dispatches Warm Nutrition in Under 45 Mins

AnnaPoorna solves the food waste dilemma through real-time hyper-local technology. In less than 30 seconds, a kitchen posts surplus meals with instant dish photo matching.

Our smart matchmaking algorithm evaluates proximity, shelter capacity, and dietary preferences — instantly alerting nearby verified NGO shelters and dispatching volunteer couriers on electric two-wheelers.

42 Mins
Average rescue & delivery turnaround
100% Safe
